content.text:
Built a complete, mobile-friendly sliding puzzle in `index.html` with original artwork in `assets/puzzle-art.svg`.

- Starts with a solvable 3×3 scramble; 4×4 is also available.
- Supports tapping adjacent tiles, touch swipes, and arrow keys.
- Includes a timer, move counter, saved best time, win message, reset-to-same-scramble, and new-game shuffle.

Verified the game in a mobile-sized browser, including tile movement and reset behavior; no browser errors were reported. Assumption: the game uses a bundled illustrated landscape rather than an uploaded photo.
